answer.response: En mars 2026, l'EBITDA s'élève à 1 278 366,78 € et la marge d'EBITDA (EBITDA / chiffre d'affaires comptable, comptes 70) à 9,4 %.
answer.sql_code:
SELECT
  SUM(l.credit - l.debit) FILTER (WHERE left(l.numero_compte,2) IN ('60','61','62','64','70','71','72','73','74')) AS ebitda,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.credit - l.debit) FILTER (WHERE left(l.numero_compte,2) IN ('60','61','62','64','70','71','72','73','74'))
        / NULLIF(SUM(l.credit - l.debit) FILTER (WHERE left(l.numero_compte,2) = '70'), 0), 1) AS marge_ebitda_pct
FROM public.ligne_ecriture l
JOIN public.ecriture e ON e.id_ecriture = l.id_ecriture
WHERE e.statut = 'VALIDEE'
  AND e.code_periode = '2026-03'
